name: AI Chat & Booking by Owlixi
author: Owlixi

sections.description:
Transform Your Website with the Ultimate AI Chatbot & Smart Booking System

Owlixi is an advanced, AI-powered chat assistant and smart booking terminal designed specifically for WordPress and WooCommerce. By training directly on your business data, Owlixi works 24/7 to engage visitors, answer complex questions, capture valuable leads, and secure bookings — all from one beautiful, customizable widget.

Designed for Every Business: Starter & Pro Plans

We believe every business deserves enterprise-grade automation. That’s why Owlixi offers two powerful tiers:
* Starter Plan (Always Free): Includes extensive features to get you started immediately! Train the AI on your site content, capture leads, use the booking terminal, and automate your customer support — completely for free, forever.
* Pro Plan: Unlock advanced capabilities for growing businesses, including deeper AI training, unrestricted data processing, premium add-ons, and priority support.

No credit card required to start. Simply install the plugin, connect your site, and watch your conversions soar!

🚀 Powerful AI Chatbot

  • One-Click Setup: Install, connect, and go live in minutes.
  • Automatic Website Learning: Owlixi scans your site and instantly learns about your business.
  • Train on Any Content: Upload website pages, PDF files, or send live updates directly via WhatsApp and Telegram.
  • Instant Messenger Training: Send voice notes, audio menu files, Word documents (DOC/DOCX), and images right from your phone. The bot learns immediately and uses this data in live customer conversations.
  • Smart Support: Automatically handles FAQs, pricing inquiries, service details, and product questions.
  • WooCommerce Ready: Helps visitors discover products, compare features, and make purchasing decisions faster.

📅 Smart Booking Terminal

  • Real-Time Bookings: Incoming requests appear instantly for your team to manage.
  • Messenger Notifications: Get instant booking and lead alerts delivered straight to your WhatsApp or Telegram.
  • Unlimited Staff Access: Your entire team can collaborate and manage requests from one unified terminal.
  • Perfect for Any Niche: Restaurants, salons, clinics, consultants, agencies, and more.

📊 AI Analytics and Reports

  • Receive automated booking stats and conversion reports in your favorite messenger.
  • Monitor chatbot performance and lead generation directly from the WordPress admin mini-dashboard.

🌍 Multilingual Support

The WordPress plugin interface, widget, and notifications are fully localized in:
* English (US, UK, CA, AU, NZ)
* German (DE, AT, CH, LI, LU)
* French (FR, BE, CH, CA, LU)
* Spanish (ES, MX, AR, CO, CL, PE)
* Italian (IT, CH, SM)
* Polish (PL, UK, DE, IE)
* Russian (RU, KZ, BY, LV, EE)
* Ukrainian (UA, PL, CA)
* Chinese (TW, HK, MO, CN, SG)

🔒 External Services & Privacy

This plugin connects to the Owlixi cloud service to deliver its AI chat and booking features.

Data sent to the service includes your site URL, site token, administrator email, and visitor chat/booking messages. Data transmission only occurs after the administrator explicitly enables consent in the plugin settings and clicks “Connect Owlixi”.

You retain full control and can request complete data deletion at any time by disconnecting the plugin or contacting our support team.

Privacy policy: Privacy Policy
Terms of use: Terms of Use
Pricing: Pricing
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugins screen, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the Owlixi menu in WordPress Admin.
  4. Enable External Services consent and save settings.
  5. Click Connect Owlixi to create or link your account.
  6. Enable the chat widget.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free and open source. It connects to the Owlixi cloud service, which has a free Starter plan.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The AI widget can process your WooCommerce catalog and answer product-related questions.

Can I train the AI with my own content?

Yes. You can train it from site pages, PDFs, WhatsApp, and Telegram updates.

Does the plugin send data before consent?

No. External services remain disabled until an administrator explicitly enables consent and connects the site.
